title: Benchmarking Clinical Decision Pathway Adherence in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.26592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Following clinical decision pathways (CDPs) defined by clinical practice guidelines is essential for safe and reliable medical decision-making. However, existing medical large language model (LLM) benchmarks mainly evaluate final-answer accuracy, providing limited evaluation of models' ability to adhere to guidelines. To address this gap, we introduce MEGA-CDP, a benchmark for evaluating whether medical LLMs can generate guideline-adherent CDPs using provided guidelines as references. MEGA-CDP is constructed from 2,274 English and Chinese clinical practice guidelines through a guideline-to-case pipeline, yielding 42,353 clinical cases with explicit reference CDPs. It supports both single-turn vignette and multi-turn interactive settings, and introduces a CDP-oriented evaluation framework for measuring pathway consistency. translated_title: 大型语言模型中临床决策路径遵循度的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26592v1 公告类型：新 摘要：遵循临床实践指南定义的临床决策路径（CDP）对于安全可靠的医疗决策至关重要。然而，现有的医学大型语言模型（LLM）基准主要评估最终答案的准确性，对模型遵循指南能力的评估有限。为解决这一缺口，我们引入了MEGA-CDP，一个基准测试，用于评估医学LLM是否能以提供的指南为参考生成符合指南的CDP。MEGA-CDP基于2,274份中英文临床实践指南，通过“指南到案例”流程构建，生成42,353个具有明确参考CDP的临床案例。它支持单轮情景和多轮交互设置，并引入了一个面向CDP的评估框架来衡量路径一致性。对16个代表性LLM的实验表明，当前模型实现可靠的临床决策支持仍具挑战性。
tldr: 该论文提出了MEGA-CDP基准，首次系统评估医学大语言模型遵循临床指南路径的能力，并发现现有模型在此任务上仍面临挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MEGA-CDP, the first benchmark systematically evaluating medical LLMs' adherence to clinical decision pathways, revealing that current models still face challenges in this task.
